# Cheater.cz — Miky’s Czech walkthrough

- Original source: [Robin Hood - The Legend of Sherwood (návod)](https://www.cheater.cz/pc-hry/robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood/navod/1120/)
- Author / publication: Michal “Miky” Deus; Cheater.cz.
- Language / date: Czech; publication date not verified.
- Access: Opening, later mission passages, and character descriptions inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

This independently attributed guide covers sixteen main missions and character abilities. Its introduction excludes detailed forest robbery walkthroughs. The opening emphasizes scrolls, beggar information, and manipulating the archery target to clear a route; later passages cover Robin’s rescue, the York missions, and the final Nottingham confrontation.

The inspected character section identifies Stuteley’s unlocking and binding abilities, and describes limits on Robin’s money-bag distraction. This provides another Czech comparison source alongside Roman Ficnar’s guide. Some mission instructions are very brief, and not every route or character entry was inspected.
